tools.name: usm_list
tools.description: List all .usm files in a directory with id, type, version, and summary. Optionally filter by $type.

directory.description: Directory to search (default: all .usm dirs across monorepo)

tools.name: usm_read
tools.description: Read and parse a .usm file, returning the full object plus metadata.

path.description: Path to the .usm file (relative to monorepo root or absolute)

tools.name: usm_search
tools.description: Search all .usm files for a query string. Returns matching files with excerpts and relevance scores.

tools.name: usm_query
tools.description: Query all .usm files with a predicate expression — typed impact analysis instead of grepping raw YAML.

query.description: Predicate query, e.g. 'features where status = planned'

tools.name: usm_summary
tools.description: Get a quick summary of a .usm file — id, type, version, summary, and type-specific counts.

tools.name: usm_references
tools.description: Find all .usm files that reference a target $id. Useful for impact analysis.

tools.name: usm_draft_feature
tools.description: Draft a feature .usm spec from structured fields. Validates against the v1 schema and returns YAML + markdown preview. Does NOT write to disk.

tools.name: usm_write_feature
tools.description: Write a feature .usm file to disk. Validates the YAML against the v1 schema before writing atomically.

yaml.description: YAML content of the feature .usm file

path.description: Target file path (relative to monorepo root or absolute)

tools.name: usm_write_service
tools.description: Create or replace a service .usm file. Validates against the v1 schema ($type: service) before writing atomically.

yaml.description: Full YAML content of the service .usm file

tools.name: usm_write_system
tools.description: Create or replace a system.usm file. Validates against the v1 schema ($type: system) before writing atomically.

yaml.description: Full YAML content of the system.usm file

tools.name: usm_update_feature
tools.description: Update fields on an existing feature .usm file. Id-bearing arrays (contracts, flows, tests, decisions) are merged by id.

fields.description: JSON object of fields to update

replace.description: JSON array of field names to replace wholesale

tools.name: usm_update_feature_status
tools.description: Update the status of a feature (planned → in-progress → built → deprecated). Enforces valid transitions.

tools.name: usm_update_service
tools.description: Update fields on an existing service .usm file. Id-bearing arrays (data_models, routes, modules) are merged by id.

fields.description: JSON object of fields to update

replace.description: JSON array of field names to replace wholesale

tools.name: usm_update_system
tools.description: Update fields on an existing system.usm file. Id-bearing arrays (services, index, roles) are merged by id.

fields.description: JSON object of fields to update

replace.description: JSON array of field names to replace wholesale

tools.name: usm_validate
tools.description: Validate a .usm file (by path) or inline YAML content against the v1 JSON Schema. Returns { valid, errors }.

path.description: Path to the .usm file to validate

tools.name: usm_get_contracts
tools.description: Get the contracts array from a feature .usm file. Each contract has id, description, applies_after, and must_have.

tools.name: usm_get_flows
tools.description: Get the flows array from a feature .usm file. Each flow has id, name, description, and steps.

tools.name: usm_report_feedback
tools.description: Report a bug, improvement, or question as a structured $type: feedback entry in .usm/feedback/.
